title: Diagonally-Weighted Generalized Method of Moments Estimation for Gaussian Mixture Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2507.20459v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: With direct computation of moments through order $L$ in $d$ dimensions, standard method of moments (MM) incurs $\Omega(d^L)$ computation and storage costs, and standard generalized method of moments (GMM) additionally requires estimating and inverting an often ill-conditioned covariance matrix of size $\Omega(d^L)$-by-$\Omega(d^L)$ to obtain the optimal weighting matrix. Pereira, Kileel, and Kolda [arXiv:2202.06930 (2022)] avoid the tensor computation cost of MM through implicit moment computation. Despite this progress, incorporating statistically principled weighting while preserving computational efficiency remains an important challenge, particularly at low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), where sampling variances can differ substantially across moment orders. translated_title: 用于高斯混合建模的对角加权广义矩估计方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2507.20459v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：在 d 维空间中直接计算 L 阶以内的矩时，标准的矩方法（MM）会产生 Ω(d^L) 量级的计算与存储成本；而标准的广义矩方法（GMM）在此之外还需要估计并求逆一个大小为 Ω(d^L)×Ω(d^L)、且常常病态的协方差矩阵以获得最优加权矩阵。Pereira、Kileel 和 Kolda [arXiv:2202.06930 (2022)] 通过隐式矩计算避免了 MM 的张量计算成本。尽管取得了这一进展，如何在保持计算效率的同时引入具有统计学依据的加权仍然是一个重要挑战，尤其是在低信噪比（SNR）的情形下，不同矩阶数的采样方差可能差异巨大。我们提出了对角加权广义矩方法（DGMM），该方法通过对最优加权矩阵的结构化近似，为每个矩阶数分配一个自适应权重……
tldr: 本文提出对角加权广义矩估计方法（DGMM），通过对最优加权矩阵的结构化近似为每个矩阶数分配自适应权重，从而在低信噪比下以极低的计算与存储成本实现高斯混合模型的统计高效估计。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces diagonally-weighted GMM (DGMM), which assigns one adaptive weight to each moment order via a structured approximation of the optimal weighting matrix, enabling statistically efficient Gaussian mixture estimation at low computational cost, particularly in low-SNR settings.
